referenceHierarchy: The user's latest favourite, landonorris.com, leads the visual composition. Apple and Linear inform precise controls, hierarchy and interaction. Hospitality references inform useful guest tasks.
method: Agent Reach Jina Reader plus direct public HTML inspection. No browser session, interaction playback or screenshot inspection.

observedPatterns.pattern: Different headline line breaks for mobile and desktop
observedPatterns.evidence: The h1 contains separate show-mobile/hide-mobile line spans. Animated visual copies are aria-hidden, with one visually hidden semantic copy.
observedPatterns.augustoApplication: Give the oversized hotel headline intentional mobile line breaks and one accessible name; avoid accidental duplicate announcements.

observedPatterns.pattern: Line-level entrance rather than animating every character
observedPatterns.evidence: Headline line spans declare opacity 0, blur(10px) and translateY(20%) in initial inline styles.
observedPatterns.augustoApplication: Use one brief, deliberate entrance for hotel title lines. Keep readable SSR/reduced-motion fallbacks; do not inherit the reference's hidden initial state without recovery.
observedPatterns.limit: Duration, easing, final state and reduced-motion behavior were not verified through playback.

observedPatterns.pattern: The actual product supplies the visual proof
observedPatterns.evidence: The hero combines its proposition with a large product interface and concrete activity/state examples. Later sections follow distinct product tasks.
observedPatterns.augustoApplication: Make real Augusto rooms and dining photography the visual proof. Follow the guest journey through rooms, meals, arrival and enquiry instead of decorative dashboard-like cards.

observedPatterns.evidence: The site navigation separates direct links from Product/Resources buttons carrying aria-expanded. A mobile trigger declares aria-haspopup=dialog.
observedPatterns.augustoApplication: Use a clear hotel navigation hierarchy, accurate expanded states, reliable Escape/focus handling and direct booking access.
observedPatterns.limit: HTML establishes control semantics; actual focus trapping and menu motion were not tested.

observedPatterns.pattern: Feedback is tied to the current task
observedPatterns.evidence: The demonstration markup includes labelled actions, status changes and selected workflow context.
observedPatterns.augustoApplication: Make selected room, requested rooms, night count, active image, input errors and ready-to-send enquiry state visibly respond to the guest's action. Use motion to explain those changes.

observedPatterns.pattern: Responsive media rather than one oversized file everywhere
observedPatterns.evidence: The public page uses image delivery URLs with automatic formats, scale-down behavior and explicit width parameters.
observedPatterns.augustoApplication: Keep Augusto's responsive local WebP variants for static export and Next's image optimizer for server deployment. Preserve genuine assets and their provenance.

doNotTransfer: SaaS interface screenshots, workflow terminology, customer logos, statistics or product claims.
The animated dot-grid and perpetual product-demo sequences merely as decoration.
Hidden content without a robust visible fallback, elaborate loading gates or scroll hijacking.
Unverified exact animation durations, contrast values or perceived performance claims.
accessLimits: Jina and direct HTML both returned substantial public content.
Requests to discovered static.linear.app CSS files returned HTTP403; no access-control workaround or browser retry was attempted because another agent owned the browser.
Current CSS colors, typography sizes, hover durations, responsive rendering and motion quality therefore remain unverified by this review.
